items.title: 10.2 Magnetic flux aur flux density (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.2 in the book's order (PDF 232-233), with Example 10.2 and a self-check.

blocks.text: Jaise electric field ko lines se dikhate hain, waise hi magnetic field B ki strength (zor) ko bhi lines of force se dikha sakte hain. Field ke perpendicular rakhi kisi surface (oopar ki teh) ke fi unit area (jagah ka phailao) se jitni lines guzarti hain, woh magnetic flux ko batati hain. Yani:

blocks.title: Magnetic flux
blocks.text: Kisi area A ke tukre se magnetic flux us area se guzarne wali magnetic lines ki number (ginti) hai.
Agar B field ke perpendicular rakhe unit area se guzarne wali lines ki number ho, to field ke perpendicular area A ke liye:

blocks.alt: Horizontal (zameen ke barabar leta hua) magenta field lines, B, daen taraf ek jhuke hue peele flat area se guzarti hain. Area se hara vector A, us ka normal, field ki direction (dashed line) se angle θ par oopar uthta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.5: Flat (chapta, seedha) area A jis ka normal (surface par seedhi khari line) B se angle (kona) θ banata hai (kitab ki Figure 10.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Area ka normal A, field B se θ angle banata hai. Jitni lines area se guzarti hain woh area ke us hisse par depend karti hain jo field ke perpendicular (90° par khara) nazar aata hai, is liye flux = BA cosθ.

Ho sakta hai surface A field ke perpendicular na ho, yani surface ka normal (surface par seedhi khari line) B se angle θ banaye (Fig. 10.5). Tab hum B ka woh hissa (component) lete hain jo vector area A ke saath hai, yani B cosθ (Fig. 10.6). Is liye surface se guzarne wala flux:

blocks.alt: Vector B horizontal daen taraf; vector A usi point se angle θ par oopar. B ke sire se A par perpendicular dashed line; A par us point tak ka hissa B cosθ hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.6: B ka vector area A ke saath component (hissa) B cosθ (kitab ki Figure 10.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: B ko do hisson mein torein: A ke saath wala hissa B cosθ aur A ke perpendicular hissa. Sirf A ke saath wala hissa area se guzarta hai, is liye ϕ_B = (B cosθ) A = B.A.
B aur A dono vectors hain, is liye yun bhi likh sakte hain:
Eq. (10.6) batati hai ke ϕ_B scalar quantity (sirf amount, direction nahi) hai (kitab mein 'scaler' chhapa hai). Is liye magnetic flux ki definition (matlab ka bayan) yeh hai:

blocks.title: Magnetic flux
blocks.text: Uniform magnetic field B mein area A ke plane (chapta, seedha) tukre se magnetic flux ϕ_B, B aur A ka dot product hai.

A aisa vector hai jis ki amount (kitna) tukre ka area hai aur direction surface ke normal ki taraf; θ, B aur A ke darmiyan angle hai (Fig. 10.5). Fig. 10.7(a) mein field area ke normal ki taraf hai, to θ = 0 (cos0° = 1) aur flux sab se zyada, BA ke barabar hai. Jab field area ki surface ke parallel ho (Fig. 10.7(b)), to field aur normal ka angle 90° hai (cos90° = 0), is liye flux zero hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Peela area horizontal field lines B ke aar paar khara hai aur hara vector A field ke saath hai. (b) Peela area field lines B ke saath leta hua hai aur A seedha oopar, B se 90° par.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.7: (a) Field area ke normal ke saath: flux zyada se zyada; (b) field area ke parallel (saath saath, barabar faasle par): flux zero (kitab ki Figure 10.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein A aur B ek hi direction mein hain: θ = 0, cos 0 = 1, sab lines area se guzarti hain, flux = BA. (b) mein area lines ke saath leta hai: A aur B ka angle 90°, cos 90 = 0, koi line area ko paar nahi karti, flux = 0.
Agar surface mudi hui (curved) ho, to use bohat se chhote chhote tukron mein baant lete hain, har tukra flat maan lete hain, aur Eq. (10.5) se har tukre ka flux nikal kar sab jama karte hain.

Tesla ki definition se magnetic flux ki unit N m A⁻¹ hai, jise weber (Wb) kehte hain. Kitab ke mutabiq Eq. 10.5 se magnetic induction B, B ke perpendicular surface ke fi unit area ka flux hai (yeh baat Eq. 10.4, B = ϕ/A, mein seedhi likhi hai). Isi liye B ko magnetic flux density bhi kehte hain; is ki unit Wb m⁻² hai. Yani magnetic field ki strength Wb m⁻² ya N A⁻¹ m⁻¹ (tesla) mein napi jati hai.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse (a), (b), (c): har ek mein khari magenta field lines neeche ki taraf aur rectangular loop kinare se peeli patti ki tarah, field ki khari direction se 30, 45 aur 60° par jhuka hua.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.8: Uniform (har jagah ek jaisa) magnetic field mein rectangular (lamba chaukor) loop ke teen orientations (Example 10.2) (kitab ki Figure 10.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Example 10.2
blocks.problem: Taar ka ek rectangular loop 1.2 T ki uniform magnetic field mein rakha hai. Loop 25 cm lamba aur 20 cm chaura hai. Fig. 10.9 mein dikhaye teen orientations (rukh) ke liye loop se magnetic flux nikalein.
steps: Area A = 20 cm × 25 cm = 500 cm² = 5 × 10⁻² m²
(a) Loop field se 30° par hai, is liye B aur area vector A (loop ka normal) ka angle θ = 90° − 30° = 60°

blocks.alt: Teenon orientations ke liye loop ka kinara, seedha neeche vector B aur loop ke perpendicular area vector A. Loop B se 30, 45 aur 60° banata hai, aur B aur A ka angle 60, 45 aur 30° hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.9: Teenon orientations mein B, loop aur area vector A ke angle (kitab ki Figure 10.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ahem baat: Fig. 10.8 mein likhe angle (30, 45, 60°) loop aur field ke darmiyan hain, jabke formula mein θ B aur area vector A (loop ke normal) ka angle hai. Chunke A loop ke perpendicular hai, θ = 90 - (loop ka angle): 60, 45 aur 30°. Isi liye (a) mein flux sab se kam aur (c) mein sab se zyada hai.

blocks.caption: Flat area se flux
header: B aur normal ka angle θ

blocks.prompt: Magnetic flux aur flux density mein farq bataiye; in ka aapas mein kya rishta hai (comprehensive question 10.1)? Coil se flux ke liye magnetic field zaroori hai, magar field hone se flux zaroori nahi; explain (wazahat) kijiye (short question 10.9).
blocks.explanation: Rishta: ϕ_B = BA cosθ, ya perpendicular area ke liye B = ϕ/A. Short question 10.9: agar coil ki surface field ke saath leti ho to B aur normal ka angle 90° aur cos90° = 0 hai, is liye field maujood hone ke bawajood coil se koi flux nahi guzarta.

rows: Kisi area se guzarne wali magnetic field lines ki number
Field ke perpendicular surface ke fi unit area se guzarne wala flux
Scalar quantity: ϕ_B = B·A = BA cosθ
Vector quantity: direction field ki direction hai
Unit Wb m⁻² = tesla (T) = N A⁻¹ m⁻¹
Area aur us ke angle par depend karta hai
Sirf field ki strength batata hai: B = ϕ/A

items: Magnetic flux: area se guzarne wali field lines ki number; B = ϕ/A (10.4); ϕ_B = BA cosθ (10.5) = B·A (10.6), scalar. Area field ke aar paar ho to flux sab se zyada, field ke saath leta ho to zero.
Flux ki unit weber: 1 Wb = 1 N m A⁻¹. B ko flux density bhi kehte hain: 1 T = 1 Wb m⁻² = 1 N A⁻¹ m⁻¹. Example 10.2: 3, 4.2 aur 5.2 × 10⁻² Wb.
